title.narrative: Building resilient futures through gender-responsive DRR, & EWS for Adaptation

description.narrative: Building Resilient Futures through Gender-Responsive Disaster Risk Reduction, Early Warning Systems, and Climate Adaptation in Eastern Africa aims to strengthen the capacities of Member States and communities to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to climate-related hazards and disasters. The programme will support the development of inclusive and gender-responsive DRR strategies aligned with the Sendai Framework and the Sendai Gender Action Plan, while promoting early warning systems, risk literacy, and evidence-based policymaking. Through regional collaboration, knowledge generation, youth engagement, and science-driven approaches, the initiative will enhance resilience among vulnerable populations, particularly women, youth, and marginalized communities, contributing to sustainable development and climate adaptation in Eastern Africa.
